messages.content: amar mone hoy ami khub judgmental, manush der niye quickly opinion baniye feli
Ki dekhe eta notice korle nijer modhhe?
ekjon notun colleague ke prothome pochondo kori nai, pore bujhlam wrong chilam
Realize korাটাই actually valuable, onek manush eta korei na. Prothome ki dekhe negative impression hoyechilo?
shayad ora kom kotha bolechilo, ami assume korechilam arrogant

Quiet behavior ke arrogance er sathe confuse kora khub common mistake actually. Ekhon jokhon eta notice koro nijer modhhe, ekta simple pause kaje ashte pare - judgment newar age ekta explanation dewar chance dao.
